defmodule MyApp.GateHelper do
  def build(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
end

defmodule MyApp.NestedTest do
  use ExUnit.Case

  setup_all do
    MyApp.Admission.admit(0)
    :ok
  end

  describe "outer" do
    setup _context do
      MyApp.Admission.admit(1)
      :ok
    end

    test "control flow" do
      if true do
        case MyApp.Admission.admit(2) do
          _ -> for x <- [3], do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
        end
      end
    end

    test "with and fn" do
      with {:ok, y} <- {:ok, 4} do
        Enum.map([y], fn z -> MyApp.Admission.admit(z) end)
      end
    end
  end

  test "after describe" do
    MyApp.Admission.admit(5)
  end
end
